scenario: Debating the pros and cons of remote work
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear go minic é i gcomhtheacsanna foirmí i gcuid de chomharthaí buntáiste.
Comhoiriúnóir chun smaointe a choinneáil i gcoinne a chéile; cuirtear sé ar dtús nó i lár abairt.
Sa chomhthéacs seo is ciall aige 'fadhb'.
Úsáidtear é chun torthaí a nochtadh.
Ag deireadh abairt is ciall aige 'ach' nó 'ar choinníoll sin'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: One clear benefit of remote work is that it can increase your productivity, don't you think?
dialogue.translation: Tá buntáiste soiléir amháin ag obair ón díon, sin gur féidir leat do tháirgeacht a mhéadú, nach bhfuil a dhóigh leat?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's true for some people. However, I've noticed several issues with it.
dialogue.translation: Is fíor sin do dhaoine áirithe. Ar choinníoll sin, tá roinnt fadhbanna agam leis.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What kind of issues? I think most problems are similar to those you'd face in an office.
dialogue.translation: Cé tusa fadhb? Cheap mé go bhfuil formhór na fadhbanna cosúil leis na fadhbanna a bhíonn agat i oifig.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Well, remote work may require a lot of self-discipline. If you don't manage your time well, you'll likely fall behind.
dialogue.translation: Go maith, d'fhéadfadh go mbeadh obair ón díon ag teastáil go leor de shibhialtacht féin. Má bhainisteáir tú do am go maith, is dócha go gcuirfidh tú isteach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see your point. But companies should provide proper training and tools to help employees, though.
dialogue.translation: Táim ag feiceáil do phoin. Ach ba chóir do chomhlachtaí oiliúint cheart agus uirlisí a sholáthar chun cabhrú le fostaíochta, cé gur.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, they should. Therefore, it's not just about the employee's effort; the employer also has a role.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ba chóir dóibh. Mar sin, ní hí an t-aon rud atá i gceist ná an iarracht a dhéanann an t-fhostaí; tá ról ag an fhostóir freisin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. And I believe the flexibility remote work offers is a huge benefit that many people value.
dialogue.translation: Go hiomlán. Agus creidim go bhfuil an ghlanmhéadú atá ar fáil ag obair ón díon leas mór atá luachmhar do dhaoine go leor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree, as long as we address the issues we mentioned. Then it can work well for everyone.
dialogue.translation: Táim sásta, a bhformhór a bhfuil muid ag déanamh de na fadhbanna a luaigh muid. Is féidir leis sin oibriú go maith do gach duine.

key_phrases.translation: Ar choinníoll sin, táim ag breathnú

scenario: Discussing a complex ethical dilemma
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é le haigeandán: avoid doing something.
Sa chomhthéacs seo, tagraítear dó mar chúis nó prionsabal ar a bhfuil gníomh déanta.
Tagraítear dó mar chinneadh idir dhá rogha nó níos mó.
Is féidir é a úsáid mar fheadach freisin: to concern = a bheith intinn.
Go minic a leanann sé haigeandán: consider doing something.
Leanann sé ainmneach nó haigeandán, ní abairt le haidhmeann.
Gaolmhar leis an eitice nó an mhoráltacht.
Ciallaíonn sé nach n-aireofar nó nach gcuirfear san áireamh.
Go minic a úsáidtear é le haigeandán: involve doing something.
Comharthaítear leis toradh, ach is coitiantaí é i gcomhthéacsanna foirmílte nó toradh.
Is féidir é a bheith físiciúl nó figiúil (brú sóisialta, oibreach, etc.).
Ag deireadh abairt ciallaíonn sé 'cé go' nó 'faraor'. Ná déan dearmad ar an gcomhpháirt 'though'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We need to decide whether to expose the company's mistake, even though it could cause a huge scandal.
dialogue.translation: Caithfimid cinneadh a dhéanamh an dtosóimid le botún an chomhlachta a nochtadh, cé go bhféadfadh sé sainscéal mhór a chruthú.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a serious ethical concern. But first, let's consider the outcome of each possible choice.
dialogue.translation: Sin imní éticeach tromchúiseach. Ach tosaigh, déanaimis áireamh de thoradh gach rogha is féidir.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: If we ignore it, we might avoid immediate problems, but the long-term damage to our reputation could be worse.
dialogue.translation: Má neamnóimid é, d'fhéadfaimis fadhbanna láithreach a sheachaint, ach d'fhéadfadh an damáiste fhadaithe do ár gcainreamh a bheith measa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: True. Yet the pressure from the board to keep this quiet is intense. They don't want any legal trouble, despite the risk.
dialogue.translation: Fíor. Ach tá an brú ón mbord seo a choimeád ciúin tinn. Ní maith leo aon trioblóid dlíthiúil, mar gheall ar an riosca.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I understand, but our decision should not involve hiding facts that affect public safety. That would be wrong.
dialogue.translation: Tuigim, ach níor cheart dár gcinneadh a bheith bainteach le fadhbanna a chur in uachtar a bhfuil tionchar acu ar shábháil phoiblí. Bhíodh sé sin mícheart.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I agree. Still, we need to think about the employees who might lose their jobs if we go public. It's a tough dilemma.
dialogue.translation: Táim sásta. fós, caithfimid smaoineamh a dhéanamh ar na fostaí atá in ann a gcuid post a chailliúint má théann muid poiblí. Is díomá é.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. But supporting the right cause sometimes means accepting some collateral damage. We can't just please everyone, though.
dialogue.translation: Go díreach. Ach tacaíocht a thabhairt don chúis cheart ciallaíonn sé sin uaireanta roinnt damáiste cheangailte a chur in áirithe. Ní féidir linn gach duine a chur sásta, cé go.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right. Let's present both sides to the board and let them decide, but we'll make sure our recommendation is clear.
dialogue.translation: Tá tú ceart. Déanaimis an dá thaobh a chur in iúl don mbord agus lig dóibh cinneadh a dhéanamh, ach déanaimis cinnte de go bhfuil ár moladh soiléir.

key_phrases.translation: an dá thaobh a chur in iúl / tuairimí

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Do you think social media has a positive effect on our community?
dialogue.translation: An smaoiníonn tú go bhfuil tionchar dhearfach ag na meáin shóisialta ar ár bpobal?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It can, especially when people share useful information, but it also affects our behavior in several ways.
dialogue.translation: Is féidir leis, go háirithe nuair a roinn daoine eolas úsáideach, ach tionchar a dhéanann sé ar ár gcomportáil i gcaoi éigin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And have you seen the data that shows how much time people spend on these platforms?
dialogue.translation: Agus an bhfaca tú na sonraí a thaispeánann cé mhéad ama a chaitear ag daoine ar na ardán seo?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it's obvious that we're more connected than ever, though sometimes that connection feels superficial.
dialogue.translation: Tá, tá sé soiléir go bhfuil muid níos comhoiriúnaí ná riamh, cé go ndéantar an ceangal sin a bheith toirmisceach uaireanta.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, do you think the overall effect is likely to be more harmful than helpful?
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, an smaoiníonn tú go bhfuil sé níos dócha go mbeidh an tionchar iomlán níos docharmaí ná cabhrach?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I'm not sure. It depends on how we use it. For example, it can be a great tool for organizing social movements.
dialogue.translation: Níl mé cinnte. Brí sin, brí sin, is brí sin. Mar shampla, is féidir é a úsáid mar uirlis mór chun gluaiseachtaí sóisialta a eagrú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: But it also spreads misinformation quickly, which can affect public opinion in a negative way.
dialogue.translation: Ach scaipeann sé eolas míchruinn go tapa chomh maith, rud a d'fhéadfadh tionchar a bheith aige ar an bpolaitíocht poiblí i gcaoi dhiúltach.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Exactly. So we need to be critical and not just accept everything we see. That's the key, though.
dialogue.translation: Go díreach. Mar sin de, caithfimid a bheith criticiúil agus gan gach rud a fheiceáil. Sin é an eochair, cé go.

scenario: Presenting a business proposal

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning, everyone. I'm here to present our proposal for the new marketing campaign.
dialogue.translation: Maidin mhaith daoibh go léir. Táim anseo chun ár gcuid toirleach don tseirbhís nua margaíochta a chur in iúl.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Thanks. We have a limited budget, so we need to ensure every dollar counts.
dialogue.translation: Go raibh maith agat. Tá buiséad teoranta againn, mar sin caithfimid a chinntiú go bhfuil gach dollar tábhachtach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Absolutely. Our strategy focuses on digital ads to reach our target audience more effectively.
dialogue.translation: Go hiomlán. Tá ár bplean dírithe ar dhíriú ar dhíriúcháin digiteacha chun ár lucht sprioc a bhaint amach níos éifeachtaí.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But how can we achieve significant growth with such a small budget?
dialogue.translation: Ach conas is féidir linn fás suntasach a bhaint amach le buiséad beag den sórt sin?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Although the budget is small, we can leverage social media, which is popular among our potential clients.
dialogue.translation: Cé go bhfuil an buiséad beag, is féidir linn na meáin shóisialta a úsáid, atá an-coitianta idir ár gcustaiméirí dúshláin.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds promising. What about our current campaigns? Should we replace them?
dialogue.translation: Fuaimíonn sin go maith. Cad fúinn a dhéanamh maidir lenár gcampaí reatha? An dtabainn iad a athrú?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.translation: Déanfaimid iad a chur in oiriúnacht, ní dhéanfaimid iad a athrú. Mar sin, is féidir linn comhréireacht a choimeád agus smaointe nua a thástáil.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.translation: Ceart go leor, feicim an dúshláin. Déanaimis plé níos faide ar an ábhar seo i gcomhair ár gcuid chruinnithe eile.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been feeling a lot of stress lately, but I haven't talked to anyone about it.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé ag mothú go leor strus le déanaí, ach ní labhair mé le haon duine faoi.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's important to be open about these things. I found that talking to a friend really helps.
dialogue.translation: Tá sé tábhachtach a bheith oscailte faoi na rudaí seo. D'aimsigh mé go dtí gur chabhraigh sé go mór le labhairt le cara.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I know, but I don't want to burden anyone. I feel I should handle it alone.
dialogue.translation: Is eol dom, ach ní maith liom aon duine a chur i bhfionraí. Is maith liom gur chóir dom é a dhéanamh ar m'aon.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're not alone, though. Asking for support is a sign of strength, not weakness.
dialogue.translation: Níl tú ar do m'aon, fiú. Is comhartha neart é iarratas a dhéanamh ar thacaíocht, ní néantóireacht.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true. Do you have any advice on how to reduce this feeling of being overwhelmed?
dialogue.translation: Sin fíor. An bhfuil aon chomhairle agat faoi conas an mothú seo a bheith thar barr a laghdú?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, since exercise works well for me, I try to walk every day. It helps improve my mood.
dialogue.translation: Sea, mar oibríonn aisce go maith dom, déanaim iarracht siúl gach lá. Cabhraíonn sé le feabhas a chur ar mo mhuinín.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've heard that, but I never seem to find the time. Maybe I can go through a simple routine at home.
dialogue.translation: Chuala mé sin, ach ní fheicim go bhfuil an t-am agam riamh. B'fhéidir gur féidir liom rud éigin a dhéanamh trí réimse shimplí sa bhaile.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a good start. Just remember, you don't have to face this alone, and there's always support available.
dialogue.translation: Sin tús maith. Cuimhnigh, níl ort é a dhéanamh ar do m'aon, agus tá tacaíocht ar fáil i gcónaí.

scenario: Talking about urban vs rural living
frequency_note: words ranked ~1500–3000 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Úsáid ar deireadh abairt chun a choinneáil

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After living in the city for five years, I'm seriously thinking about moving outside the urban area.
dialogue.translation: Tar éis bheith ag cónaí sa chathair le cúig bliana, táim ag smaoineamh go trom chun gluaiseacht lasmuigh den cheantar uirbeach.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Really? I find cities quite convenient — you have access to everything you need within a short walk.
dialogue.translation: D'aithin? Tá cathracha leor oifigiúil dom - tá rocht agat chuig gach rud is gá duit laistigh de shiúlóg ghearr.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's true, but the constant noise and crowded streets drain me. I want a more peaceful environment.
dialogue.translation: Sin fíor, ach tá an t-ainmneacht leanúnach agus na sráideanna plódaithe ag cur as dom. Theastaíonn timpeallacht suaimhneasach níos mó uaim.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I understand. However, rural areas often lack basic facilities like hospitals or good schools.
dialogue.translation: Tuigim. Ar ndóigh, ní mór do cheantair tuaithe gan áiseanna bunúsacha cosúil le ospidéil nó scoileanna maith.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That's a fair point. But with remote work, I don't depend on the city for my job anymore.
dialogue.translation: Sin pointe maith. Ach le hobair ghairid, níl brath orm ar an gcathair ar mo chuid oibre níos mó.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: What about social life and career opportunity? You might feel isolated after a while, though.
dialogue.translation: Cad fá dhearbhú sóisialta agus deiseanna gairme? D'fhéadfá a bheith ina bhfuil tú i bhfad ó chéile, cé gur.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've considered that. But the cost of housing in the city is insane — I can't afford a decent place anymore.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé ar an eolas sin. Ach tá costais tithíochta sa chathair go hiontach - ní féidir liom áit mhaith a fháil níos mó.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: You're right, it's a real trade-off. Perhaps a small town outside the city could give you the best of both worlds.
dialogue.translation: Tá tú ceart, is iontach é an t-ioncam. B'fhéidir go dtabharfadh baile beag lasmuigh den chathair duit an fear is fearr de na domhanda.

dialogue.speaker: B

dialogue.text: I agree, but it's not always a free choice for everyone; some people face strong family pressure.
dialogue.translation: Tá mé d'eagar, ach níl sé i gceist go bhfuil rogha saor ag gach duine; tá brú teaghlaigh láidir ag daoine áirithe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's keep pushing for change, then. Every small step counts.
dialogue.translation: Lig dom a choinneáil ag tabhairt faoi athrú, ansin. Tá gach céim beag tábhachtach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: After that trip, I began to realize that my life had changed entirely.
dialogue.translation: Tar éis an aistir sin, thosaigh mé ag aithint go raibh mo shaol athraithe go hiomlán.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, I know what you mean. I found a new purpose in my work, though it was not easy.
dialogue.translation: Sea, is eol dom cad atá i gceist agat. D'aimsigh mé cuspóir nua i mo chuid oibre, cé go raibh sé deacair.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Now I value every moment, and I accept that some things are beyond my control.
dialogue.translation: Anois luachaim gach nóiméad, agus glacaim leis gur iomaí rud atá taobh amuigh de mo smacht.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That is a strong memory for you, I suppose. It gave you strength.
dialogue.translation: Sin cuimhne laethanta duit, deimhnigh mé. Thug sé neart duit.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. That experience taught me to continue even when things get hard.
dialogue.translation: Go díreach. Mhúin an taithí sin dom leanúint ar aghaidh fiú nuair a bhíonn na rudaí deacair.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I feel the same. It was a period of personal growth for both of us.
dialogue.translation: Is é an méid céanna atá mé ag éirí. Bhí sé ina tréimhse forais phearsanta d'aon ní againn.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Indeed. Looking back, I am grateful for the whole journey.
dialogue.translation: Go deimhin. Nuair a dhéanaim sracfhéachaint ar an am atá caite, tá mé buíoch as an turas iomlán.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So am I. We should talk about it more often, but perhaps not today.
dialogue.translation: Is buíoch mé freisin. Ba chóir dúinn a labhairt faoi níos minice, ach b'fhéidir nach bhfuil sé inniu.

scenario: Discussing the role of humor in communication

vocabulary.note: Úsáidtear é chun caint faoi mheás nó intinn rud éigin.
Téigh i bhfad díreach ó rud éigin nó duine éigin.
Sa chomhthéacs seo, ciallaíonn sé 'taispeáint' (to seem) nó 'a bheith le feiceáil' (to show up).
Téigh i gcoinne ábhar nó scéimh ar bhealach áirithe.
Atá sé gan mhoill nó atá sé an-díreach.
Lean úsáid a bhaint as rud éigin (cairdeas, dearcadh, etc.).
Tá torthaí maith nó dearcadh maith leis.
Tá sé deimhnithe go ndéanfaidh rud éigin tarlú.
Úsáidtear é chun ráitis a chur ina luí (go leor) nó chun toiliú a nochtadh (níos fearr).
Tá sé thar teorainn nó pointe áirithe.
Ag deireadh abairt, ciallaíonn sé 'fiú' nó 'ach'. (Nota: níl sé in úsáid mar comhfhocal anseo).
Tá sé riachtanach go ndéanfaidh rud éigin tarlú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think humor has a huge impact on communication, but its success depends on the degree of trust between people.
dialogue.translation: Ceapaim go bhfuil tionchar mhór ag an ngéimneach ar chumarsáid, ach bríonn a rath ar an gcéim iomaíochta idir daoine.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Absolutely. If you don't know someone well, you should avoid jokes that could be misinterpreted.
dialogue.translation: Go hiomlán. Mura bhfuil a fhios agat faoi dhuine go maith, ba cheart duit géimneacha a sheachaint a d'fhéadfadh a bheith míthreoraithe.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. A joke might appear funny to you, but it can seem offensive to the other person.
dialogue.translation: Go díreach. D'fhéadfadh sé gur gile duit é, ach is féidir leis a bheith tinn do dhuine eile.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So, how do you approach humor at work, then? I find that a light joke can make the atmosphere more positive.
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, conas a dtéann tú i gcoinne géimneach ag obair? Tá a fhios agam go bhfuil sé in ann an atmósfar a dhéanamh níos dearfacha.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I try to use it, but the immediate reaction is not always good. Sometimes people just stare at you.
dialogue.translation: Déanaim iarracht é a úsáid, ach níl an freagra láithreach i gcónaí maith. Tá daoine ag féachaint ort go minic.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Right. I think the key is to maintain a balance. Don't force it, and read the room first.
dialogue.translation: Ceart go leor. Ceapaim go bhfuil an eochair chun eilíniú a choimeád. Ná déan é a chur i gcrích, agus léigh an seomra i dtósach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: True. If you do it too often, your colleagues will likely stop taking you seriously, though.
dialogue.translation: Fíor. Má dhéanann tú é ró-minic, is dócha go bhfuil do chomhghleacaithe ag stopadh uait go héifeachtach, fiú.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, humor is rather powerful. It goes beyond simple laughter. It builds bonds, but unless you are careful, it can also break them.
dialogue.translation: Tá, tá cumhacht mhór ag an ngéimneach. Téann sé thar gáire shimplí. Déanann sé naisc a thógáil, ach murar cúramach, is féidir leis iad a bhriseadh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've finished analyzing the data from our latest survey. Do you want to see the results?
dialogue.translation: Tá anailís déanta agam ar na sonraí ón suirbhé is déanaí againn. An bhfuil fonn ort na torthaí a fheiceáil?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, please! Did you compare the responses from the two different age groups?
dialogue.translation: Tá, le do thoil! An d'rinne tú comparáid idir na freagraí ó na grúpaí aois difriúla?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Of course. According to the initial figures, the younger group shows a significant increase in usage.
dialogue.translation: Ar ndóigh. De réir na gcuntais tosaigh, tá méadú suntasach le feiceáil sa úsáid sa ghrúpa níos óige.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's interesting. Did you observe any other notable patterns in that sample?
dialogue.translation: Sin suimiúil. An bhfaca tú aon phatrúin eile suntasach sa shampla sin?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, we saw a clear trend: the older group's numbers remained stable, although they started from a higher point.
dialogue.translation: Tá, bhí treocht soiléir againn: fanacht le stáitisticí na grúpa níos sine, cé go raibh siad ag tús ó phointe níos airde.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: So the findings are quite similar to last year's study, but with a sharper contrast in the younger demographic.
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, tá na torthaí cosúil go leor leis an staidéar anuraidh, ach le do-chomhréir níos soiléire sa phobal níos óige.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. This clearly demonstrates that our new approach is working as intended.
dialogue.translation: Go díreach. Léiríonn sé go soiléir go bhfuil ár gcuid de rochtain nua ag obair de réir mar a bhí beartaithe.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Excellent. Let's prepare the final report and present these findings to the team tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Iontrálach. Déanaimis ullmhú ar an achoimre deiridh agus cuirfimid na torthaí seo os comhair an fhoireann amárach.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading about the income gap in our country, and it's shocking how wide it has become.
dialogue.translation: Bhí mé ag léamh faoi bhréagna na dtioncnaí inár dtír, agus tá sé ina chosúil go bhfuil sé leathan go leor.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, but the real problem is the lack of opportunity for those from a poor background to improve their situation.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ach is é an fhadhb dhíoscaoilte é an easpa deiseanna do dhaoine ó chúlra bocht a gcás a fheabhsú.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Despite all the talk about equal rights, many people still struggle to get a decent job.
dialogue.translation: Ceann ar bith de na cainteanna faoi chearta comhionanna, tá daoine fírinneach ag déanamh iarracht mór chun post maith a fháil.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Therefore, social mobility is almost impossible for them; they remain stuck in the same class.
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, is dócha nach féidir leo a bheith i bhfad ó a chéile; fanann siad ina gcónaí sa gcéad dream céanna.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: However, I know a few cases where people managed to rise despite their humble beginnings.
dialogue.translation: Áamh, is eol dom roinnt cásanna ina raibh daoine in ann a bheith i bhfad ó a chéile ceann ar bith de na tosaithe bochta.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But those are rare exceptions; the wealth is concentrated in a few hands, and that's the core issue.
dialogue.translation: Ach sin roinnt de na heacnamaíochtaí a bhíonn ann; tá an maoin go léir i láimh le roinnt daoine, sin an príomhfhadhb.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So, what can we do to change this? Maybe better education is the answer.
dialogue.translation: Mar sin, cad is féidir linn a dhéanamh chun é a athrú? B'fhéidir go bhfuil an freagra i dteagasc níos fearr.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Education helps, but we also need policies that directly address the gap, otherwise nothing will really change.
dialogue.translation: Cabhraíonn an t-oideachas, ach tá a dhéanamh linn beartais a dhéanamh a chuireann fúthu an bhréagna, mura mbeadh aon rud eile a dhéanamh, ní bheidh aon rud ar bith a dhéanamh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I think the best way to manage a project is to be flexible with your team.
dialogue.translation: Ceapaim go bhfuil an bealach is fearr le tionscadal a bhainistiú ná a bheith spleách le do fhoireann.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: But if you're too flexible, people may not take their responsibility seriously.
dialogue.translation: Ach más spleách tú ró-mhór, b'fhéidir nach gcuirfidh daoine a gcuid freagra iomlán.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I prefer to lead by supporting others rather than giving strict orders.
dialogue.translation: Is fearr liom ceannaireacht a dhéanamh trí tacaíocht a thabhairt do dhaoine eile ná ordú diana a thabhairt.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: In my experience, a leader must have authority and make decisions quickly.
dialogue.translation: De réir mo thaithí, caithfidh ceannaire a bheith ina údarás agus cinntí a dhéanamh go tapaidh.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, but the most effective leaders direct without being authoritarian.
dialogue.translation: Sea, ach stiúraíonn na ceannairí is éifeachtaí gan a bheith údaráiseach.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Maybe you're right. A strict style can work, but it may not be the best for every team.
dialogue.translation: B'fhéidir go bhfuil tú ceart. Is féidir le stíl diana oibriú, ach b'fhéidir nach é an fear is fearr do gach foireann é.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Exactly. So, how do you usually manage conflict within your team?
dialogue.translation: Go díreach. Mar sin, conas a bhainistíonn tú cogadh laistigh de do fhoireann de ghnáth?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I try to support each person and give them more responsibility when they're ready.
dialogue.translation: Déanaim iarracht tacaíocht a thabhairt do gach duine agus tuilleadh freagra a thabhairt dóibh nuair atá siad réidh.
